findings.claim: The exclusion rationale for NCT00816673 mistakes a placebo label containing Circadin for active treatment in both arms. The supplied AACT arm index places Circadin in only one arm, contradicting the asserted absence of a contrast.

source_evidence.quote: Adult outpatients (791, aged 18-80 years) with primary insomnia, were treated with placebo (2 weeks) and then randomized, double-blind to 3 weeks with PRM or placebo nightly. PRM patients continued whereas placebo completers were re-randomized 1:1 to PRM or placebo for 26 weeks with 2 weeks of single-blind placebo run-out.

findings.claim: The compatibility table uses the extension-period reference to placebo completers to label the initial three-week efficacy analysis as a completers set. That passage describes entry into the subsequent 26-week period and does not establish the analysis set for the served three-week estimate.
